rules.title: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance: just cause coverage
rules.requirement: Just cause for eviction applies to fully covered units (most multifamily units built before 1980, pre-1996 single-family tenancies, rooming houses) and also to partially covered units (post-June 1980 new construction, single-family tenancies starting on or after January 1, 1996, most condominiums).

coverage.summary: Just cause applies to both fully and partially covered units, including post-1980 new construction, condominiums and post-1995 single-family tenancies.
coverage.other_conditions: Single-family tenancies and condominiums are covered; subsidy-related coverage is listed in the guide but is cut off in the passage.

rules.title: Owner move-in and Ellis Act eviction relocation assistance (2026 amounts)
rules.requirement: Owners must pay tenants relocation assistance for an owner move-in eviction, and the Ellis Implementation Ordinance requires the same payments when an owner removes a property from the rental market. Payments are indexed to inflation and the Rent Board publishes the annual increases.
rules.key_value: Standard payment $19,413; additional payment for qualifying households $6,471; effective January 1, 2026 (1.5% CPI adjustment)

coverage.summary: Applies to owner move-in and Ellis Act withdrawal evictions.

rules.effective_date_note: Date applies to the 2026 adjusted amounts; the underlying requirement predates it.
citation_aliases: Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: The Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance requires owners to pay tenants relocation assistance in the event of an owner move-in eviction.
